"""CSV payload builder for the marketing_sync integration."""

_HEADER = "CONT_ID,EMAIL_TX,FRST_NM,LAST_NM,PREF_CH"
_FIELDS = ("CONT_ID", "EMAIL_TX", "FRST_NM", "LAST_NM")


def _quote_csv_field(value: str) -> str:
    """Apply RFC-4180-style quoting to one field."""
    if any(character in value for character in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
        return f'"{value.replace('"', '""')}"'
    return value


def build_payload(contacts: list[dict]) -> str:
    """Build the marketing_sync CSV payload without performing I/O."""
    rows = [_HEADER]

    for contact in contacts:
        if contact.get("DEL_FLG", "") == "Y":
            continue
        if contact.get("OPTOUT_FLG", "") == "Y":
            continue

        values = [contact.get(field, "") for field in _FIELDS]
        preferred_channel = contact.get("PREF_CH", "") or "E"
        values.append(preferred_channel)

        rows.append(",".join(_quote_csv_field(value) for value in values))

    return "\n".join(rows) + "\n"
